card.name: Start of a drug's generic name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a generic drug name, often a single letter or short start like d, l, is or if, or the bracket before it. It appears right after a brand name or in drug lists, just before the rest of the name.

modes.label: Generic name after brand
modes.description: Opening bracket or first piece of the generic name given after a brand name.

modes.label: First piece in drug lists
modes.description: A split-off first letter or syllable of a drug name inside a list of interacting drugs.

modes.label: Start of split name in text
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name such as isavuconazole or ifosfamide, in running text.

card.writes: It pushes toward continuing with name pieces like eth, meth and Phen, as in the middle of chemical-style drug names.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug's generic name is just beginning and still being spelled out.
